cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get this claim finished. At four, were you on the bus or buying coffee? You've said both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee. Can we finish the form?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do the writing. Just tell me whether the bag was beside you when you paid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver waited while I ran in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll note the waiting bus. Go over getting back on: did the bag come out with you?

reason: A takes the writing burden while asking narrower memory questions; B4 reconciles the journey timing and creates the next bag-custody test without an assumed loss location.
